name: AI_Mail_Analyzer
author: THA-CERT //ECR
description: Classifies a submitted email (safe/unwanted/dangerous, then a finer sub-class) via 5 small ResNet-MLP models over a sentence-transformer embedding of the body. See Analyzers/AIMailAnalyzer/AIMailAnalyzer.pdf.

configurationItems.name: variant
configurationItems.description: Model set the inference server answers with: 'personal' (this deployment's own trained weights, models/) or 'public' (comparison weights, models_public/). Leave as 'personal' for the analyzer that drives the case verdict.

configurationItems.name: inference_url
configurationItems.description: Base URL of the AIMailAnalyzer inference server as seen FROM a Cortex job container (Docker default bridge, no DNS): normally the bridge gateway, http://172.17.0.1:8090. See deployment/compose_apps.yaml (ai_inference).

name: Mail_Header_Analyzer
author: THA-CERT // TBH and RBA
description: Rule-based verdict on email headers: SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication results, From/Reply-To/Return-Path domain mismatches, and display-name spoofing. Accepts either a raw header block (mail_header) or a .eml file.
